newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian police seize record Mafia booty.
newsitem.headline: Italian police seize record Mafia booty.

text.p: Italian police said on Friday they had carried out their largest-ever seizure of Mafia booty, confiscating 515 billion lire ($285 million) in assets belonging to Naples-area mobsters.
Anti-Mafia police told a news conference in Caserta, near the southern port of Naples, that the assets had been seized from powerful Caserta clans of the local Mafia, the Camorra.
The assets included 206 buildings, 49 land holdings, 26 companies as well as race horses, cars, stocks and bonds.
"This is the largest confiscation (of criminal assets) ever to take place in Italy," said a police agent from the central Anti-Mafia Directorate (DIA).
The operation was ordered by a Caserta court following an investigation into the city's clans carried out by the DIA.

It was the latest seizure of criminal property since June, when police confiscated some $59 million in assets belonging to businessmen with alleged ties to the the 'Ndrangheta, the Mafia in the southern Calabria region.
The DIA probe has led to the arrests of several mobsters in recent months, the police said, adding that the Caserta court had also ordered special police surveilliance of 17 alleged clan members.

The Camorra has come under an intense crackdown recently with the government sending 500 troops and 200 police to Naples to quell in-fighting between rival clans which has claimed almost 100 lives this year. ($1=1,808 lire)
